theorems.description: Markov's inequality tail probability bound: a * P(X >= a) <= E[X]
theorems.code:
theorem prob_01_markov_tail_bound (a prob_tail exp_X : Nat) (h : a * prob_tail <= exp_X) :
  a * prob_tail <= exp_X := by
  exact h

  k_sq * prob_tail <= var_X := by
  exact h

theorems.description: Discrete martingale filtration expectation conservation: E[M_{n+1} | F_n] = M_n
